description: FieldProof illustrative clause index for automated citation validation. Each clause_id maps to a concordance outcome.

clauses.title: Standard Rainfall Index Trigger (30th Percentile)
clauses.summary: Index triggers automatic payout when seasonal rainfall falls strictly below the 30th percentile of the 1991–2020 baseline.

clauses.title: Confirmed Payout Fast-Track
clauses.summary: Index triggers AND photo evidence confirms MODERATE or SEVERE damage. Fast-track for adjuster sign-off.

clauses.title: Possible Overpayment Review
clauses.summary: Index triggers but photo evidence does NOT confirm MODERATE or SEVERE damage. Manual review required.

clauses.title: Observable Sign Rubric
clauses.summary: Photo assessment uses concept-bottleneck rubric: leaf rolling, canopy senescence, stunting (0–3), soil cracking (boolean). Severity bands set by deterministic code.

clauses.title: Visual Anchor Calibration
clauses.summary: Three reference photos (healthy, moderate, severe) calibrate model perception. Anchors excluded from test set.

clauses.title: Basis-Risk Definition
clauses.summary: Basis risk defined as area-level index not triggering while plot-level evidence confirms crop loss.

clauses.title: Phenological Basis-Risk Escalation
clauses.summary: Index does NOT trigger, MODERATE/SEVERE drought confirmed by photo, satellite stress confirmed, dry spell overlaps critical growth stage. Escalate.

clauses.title: Spatial Basis-Risk Escalation
clauses.summary: Index does NOT trigger, MODERATE/SEVERE drought confirmed by photo, satellite stress confirmed, no dry-spell overlap but plot-level rain is below county median. Escalate.

clauses.title: Evidence Conflict Hold
clauses.summary: Index does NOT trigger, photo confirms weather damage, but satellite does NOT confirm stress. Request additional photos; human review.

clauses.title: Non-Weather Peril Exclusion / Advisory Routing
clauses.summary: Damage identified as pest, disease, weed, nutrient, or other non-weather cause. Excluded from index cover; routed to advisory.

clauses.title: Mandatory Human Adjuster Sign-Off & Two-Pass Disagreement Abstention
clauses.summary: No payout without human sign-off. Two-pass disagreement (passes_agreed = false) immediately abstains to human adjuster with no automated recommendation.

clauses.title: Image Integrity Hold
clauses.summary: Photos fail integrity checks (duplicate, screen recapture, mismatched fields, EXIF issues). Claim held; no recommendation; referred to fraud team.
